prompt:
High-fidelity mobile UI design comp: one portrait phone screen filling the frame.

The app is Squirrel, a personal memory aid. This is its "chores" room, in the world of a rail concourse split-flap departure board: brushed steel chassis, matte black flap cells. This composition combines two things — rooms are numbered platforms in a left gutter, AND the next thing gets a hero row several times the height of the others.

STRUCTURE:
1. A slim brushed steel header rail, tiny wide-tracked uppercase monospace: "SQUIRREL" left, "PLATFORM 3 · CHORES" right.
2. A NARROW LEFT GUTTER running the full height, about one sixth of the width: a vertical column of platform numbers in large cream monospace — 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 — each with a tiny rotated uppercase room name beside it reading PILE, AGENDA, CHORES, TASKS, ASIDE. Platform 3 (CHORES) is current: filled bright orange (#e66d0d) with near-black numerals. Platforms 1 and 2 carry small glowing amber lamps; 4 and 5 are dark.
3. THE HERO ROW, filling the top half of the board area beside the gutter: one departure at enormous scale, framed by a thin orange border. Inside it, tiny amber monospace "NOW", then "WATER THE PLANTS" in gigantic condensed uppercase white paint lettering on matte black flap cells across two lines with visible cell divisions, then a thin rule, then tiny cream monospace "EVERY WEEK · LAST DONE A WHILE BACK". A large amber lamp glows in its top right.
4. Immediately below the hero, inside the same frame, three action cells rendered as flaps: bright orange (#e66d0d) with near-black uppercase monospace "DID IT", then matte black with cream monospace "HOW OFTEN" and "STOP ASKING".
5. BENEATH THAT, the rest of the board: four compressed single-line rows in much smaller type, each a day in cream monospace, a destination in small condensed uppercase, and a status at the right.
   "THU  BINS OUT  EVERY 2 WKS"
   "SAT  RECYCLING  EVERY 2 WKS"
   "—  DESCALE KETTLE  CANCELLED" rendered in dim red and struck through
   "MON  BLEED RADIATORS  DELAYED" rendered in amber

MATERIALS: matte black flap faces, crisp white paint letters, brushed steel chassis and gutter, amber lamps, fine mechanical shadow between flaps.
STRICT PALETTE: #17130d #0c0a07 #241f19 #fffbf3 #fed6a7 #e66d0d #b03a1e.
TYPE: one condensed uppercase sans on the flaps in fixed character cells; tiny wide-tracked uppercase monospace for times, platform names, status and actions.
MOOD: a concourse board where one departure is imminent and the rest wait their turn, and every room is a platform on the same board. Authoritative, mechanical, unarguable.
